The company has a single reportable segment, and consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥22,122 million. Originating as a wholesale trader, it is a fabless manufacturer that handles everything from marketing through planning, design, development and sales in-house. Subsidiary SHO－BI Labo Co., Ltd. handles contract manufacturing of contact lenses, and Picomonte Japan Co., Ltd. handles the manufacture and sale of cosmetics.
